one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent generated code that extracted contour coordinates from cropped bbox-region masks but never added back the (xmin, ymin) offset to convert back to global image coordinates, and accepted the incorrect output based solely on shallow checks (polyline type counts) without inspecting actual coordinate values.
t_err_evidence: masks cropped to bbox but contour coords not offset back to image frame, yielding wrong global coordinates
t_commit_evidence: At step 52, the final version of the script (written at step 51) was executed successfully and produced demo_output.csv. After step 52 the agent performed only shallow validation (polyline type counts) and made no further code changes, locking in the incorrect output.
t_surface_evidence: output CSV shows coords near 0 (e.g., xmin=3) instead of image-frame values (original xmin=43)
trigger_explanation: The agent's plan was conceptually correct (use SAM bounding-box prompts, extract contours, produce polylines), but the code generation failed to implement the required coordinate offset: after cropping the predicted mask to the bbox region and running cv2.findContours on the crop, the returned contour points must be shifted by (xmin, ymin) to map back to global image coordinates. This step was omitted in all three versions of the script (steps 3, 41, 51).
